svg.title: R-drone-P - Drone & Probe Bay - plan
svg.text: CLEAR: 2.9 m transfer lane from the corridor opening through the bay
The Drone & Probe Bay stores, services and prepares the ship's robotic fleet - survey probes, repair and
maintenance drones, a repair pod - and launches probes down a keel launch tube; crewed craft are lifted to the
Hangar Bay above, so this bay never opens to space.
Survey scout on the landing pad (north-east)
Probe launch rail and keel launch port (south wall)
Launch-prep console and seat (west wall, north of the opening)
Charging racks for probes and drones (west wall, south of the opening)
Propellant pump and hose reel (south-east facets)
Spare thruster and suit gear (south wall)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 4 - HOLD DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL -4.000
